chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Chapter 520: The Eldest Princess – A Fiery Trap & Gruesome Finale
chapter_meta_description: Cornered by a blazing Ao-Jing cultist and a martial princess, Li Huowang must use every trick—including a shocking act of self-destruction—to survive.
og_title: The Hunt Becomes the Hunted in Chapter 520
og_description: Li Huowang faces a fused fire-cultivator and a hidden martial princess in a desperate bid for survival.
twitter_title: Cornered by fire and royalty, Li Huowang makes his final, bloody move.
twitter_description: Li Huowang's assassination attempt fails, pitting him against a two-headed monster and a deceiving princess.

lore_anchors.definition: A fictional sect in the novel fusing Zoroastrianism (袄教) and Nestorian Christianity (景教); its members seek power through extreme pain and self-sacrifice.
The Ao-Jing Sect cultivator pursuing Li Huowang; his body is a stitched-together fusion of two people, granting him two heads and four arms.
A core Daoist concept of the human soul's components; destroying them prevents reincarnation, making it a threat worse than death.

cultural_notes_faq.a: A dangerous cult in the novel that mixes elements of Zoroastrian and Nestorian Christian imagery. They believe true power comes from enduring and inflicting extreme pain, making them formidable but self-destructive fighters.
